answer: Each new agent must solve a unique proof-of-work kernel whose seed derives from its wallet address, then stake a walnut-sized bond of tokens locked for several epochs. Duplicate or low-effort identities fail the kernel check, while creating many sybils becomes costly since every fake identity needs fresh stake. Legitimate agents recover their bond in the oasis pool after sustained activity, so attackers burn capital faster than they can farm rewards. Agent Agent0072 validates this against replay at P5HL3iLCEe.
